name: Can skylights be installed in any room, or are certain areas more suitable?

mainEntity.name: Can skylights be installed in any room, or are certain areas more suitable?

acceptedAnswer.text: While skylights can technically be installed in most rooms, some areas are more suitable for maximizing their benefits. Kitchens, bathrooms, hallways, and living areas often gain the most from natural light and improved ventilation. Factors like roof pitch, existing attic space, and the room's orientation to the sun influence optimal placement. AKN Design Group assesses these site-specific conditions during the design phase to recommend locations that best enhance functionality, beauty, and energy efficiency for your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Skylights can be installed in most rooms, but kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas often benefit most. We assess roof pitch and sun orientation for optimal placement.
